name: Idaho DOPL Public Works Contractors License Board Search

agency.name: Idaho Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses

updateFrequency: unknown; verify against DOPL online services before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Idaho public works contractor and construction manager license classes exposed by DOPL online services
knownExclusions: This source is limited to public works contractor and construction manager licensing and does not represent private contractor registration, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, asbestos, local permits, or business-registration records.
Private residential and private commercial contractor registration is tracked separately in us.id.dopl.contractors.
The lookup is hosted in DOPL online services; adapter work must review public search controls before automation.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Do not automate DOPL online-services pages unless official terms, result limits, and technical controls are reviewed.
publicRecordsNotes: Official lookup metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that a public works authorization, private contractor registration, local permit, or business-registration record does not exist elsewhere.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official Idaho Public Works Contractors License Board page links a DOPL online-services license search for public works contractor records.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official stable bulk download has been confirmed for Idaho public works contractor licenses in this phase.
researchNotes: Keep this source separate from contractor registration because public works contractors and construction managers are a distinct DOPL license board.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Idaho public works contractor and construction manager records, not every Idaho private construction, trade, local permit, or business-registration record.
No matching record means no match in this source at the checked time, not proof that an authorization does not exist elsewhere.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while official lookup behavior and allowed automation remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Future adapter research should distinguish public works contractor classes from general private contractor registrations.

researchEvidence.note: Official Idaho Public Works Contractors License Board page reviewed; it links DOPL online-services license search and lists public works contractor class types and construction manager licensing.

blocker.summary: The official path is lookup-oriented and no stable, documented machine-readable interface has been adapter-reviewed with offline fixtures.
